stimulus.body: Field note: 2199 steps were collected during a review of iteration, one observation per entry.

questions.stem: An execution log contains 2199 steps marked for iteration, each with a start and end marker. Which definition of iteration fits these steps?
questions.explanation: iteration: Iteration repeats a block of steps using a loop, allowing an algorithm to process many items compactly. Option D is correct: Repeating steps with a loop. Option A is wrong because it confuses iteration with sequencing. Option B is wrong because it confuses iteration with storage. Option C is wrong because it confuses iteration with selection.
